segments.text: Come on keep walking eight thousand four hundred. I still need sixteen hundred sixteen hundred watt steps
Ten thousand a day everybody knows that under that you're basically dying
Everybody knows and who told everybody doctors
Scientists my watch your watch. Do you know who picked that number?
No
Not another word watch this
Tokyo
1964 the Olympic Games turn a whole country toward fitness
The next year a clock company wants its share of the fever its product a little box that counts your steps
It needs a name. They call it Mon po K the ten thousand step meter. Why ten thousand no study
No doctor just a round number and a symbol that looks like a man walking the ads repeat it walk
Ten thousand steps a day and the box sells
The slogan outlives the box it spreads into gyms magazines health campaigns
Then come the fitness bands and smartwatches and ten thousand becomes the default goal on millions of wrists
In 2019 a harvard researcher looks for the study behind the number. There isn't one the name was a marketing tool
In 2025 a review of 57 studies most of the benefit arrives around 7 000 steps
And some who never reached 10 000
Stop walking all together
Walking is good for you that part is true
But the number was never medicine. It was a slogan that sold a box
How many of your rules did someone write just to sell you something?
You can keep counting someone else's numbers or go quiet watch learn like subscribe and evolve quietly until you're the wolf
